| `bcv` | boolean | Targets the SRDF action at the Device Group's locally-associated BCV volumes that are configured as SRDF BCV volumes. |
| `full` | boolean | Make the action a Full Establish as opposed to an Incremental Establish |
| `metroBias` | boolean | When the SRDF Mode is set to Active, this specifies to make the R1 System the Bias |

Port flag parameters that can be modified

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `volume_set_addressing` | boolean | Enable/Disable the volume set addressing mode. |
| `avoid_reset_broadcast` | boolean | Enable/Disable a SCSI bus reset to only occur to the port that received the reset (not broadcast to all channels). |
| `environ_set` | boolean | Enable/Disable the environmental error reporting by the storage system to the host on the specific iSCSI Target. |
| `disable_q_reset_on_ua` | boolean | When enabled, a Unit Attention (UA) that is propagated from another director does not flush the queue for this volume on this director. Used for hosts that do not expect the queue to be flushed on a 0629 sense (only on… |
| `soft_reset` | boolean | Supports SCSI soft reset on a iSCSI Target when enabled for a Bull/GCOS-7 host. |
| `scsi_3` | boolean | Alters the inquiry data (when returned by any volume on the port) to report that the PowerMax system supports the SCSI-3 protocol. When disabled, the SCSI-2 protocol is supported. |
| `scsi_support1` | boolean | Provides a stricter compliance with SCSI standards for managing volume identifiers, multi-port targets, unit attention reports, and the absence of a volume at LUN 0. |
| `spc2_protocol_version` | boolean | This flag should be enabled (default) in a Windows 2003 environment running Microsoft HCT test version 12.1. When setting this flag, the port must be offline. |
| `open_vms` | boolean | Enable/Disable an Open VMS fiber connection. |
| `isid_protected` | boolean | Protected initiator session identifier. When this flag is set, the system uses the ISID and iSCSI name to calculate the World Wide Name (WWN) in the Persistent Group Registration (PGR) record. |

| `symForce` | boolean | Requests the System force operation be executed when normally it is rejected. Use extreme caution when using this option. CAUTION: Use care when applying symforce, as data could be lost or corrupted. Use of this option… |
| `bypass` | boolean | Bypasses any existing System exclusive locks during an SRDF operation. WARNING: Only use this flag if you are certain no other SRDF operation is in progress at the local and/or remote System. |
| `star` | boolean | Targets the action at volumes in STAR mode. |
| `hop2` | boolean | Targets the SRDF action at the group's second-hop volumes in a cascaded SRDF relationship. For example, in an RDF1 group, the action targets the R21->R2 pair of the R1->R21->R2 relationship. |
| `r1` | boolean | Operation is targeted at the source (R1) side |

| `flr_max_ret` | string | The longest retention period for which files on an FLR-enabled file system can be locked and protected from deletion. Any attempt to lock a file for more than this maximum retention period results in the file being… |
| `flr_auto_lock` | boolean | Indicates whether to automatically lock files in an FLR-enabled file system. When true files are locked automatically after modification based on the flrPolicyInterval interval. When enabled, auto-locked files are set… |
| `flr_auto_delete` | boolean | Indicates whether locked files will be automatically delete from an FLR-enabled file system once their retention periods have expired. Values: - true - automatic delete is enabled on the file system. - false -… |
| `flr_policy_interval` | integer (int32) | Indicates how long to wait (in seconds) after files are modified before the files are automatically locked. This setting can only be applied to mounted FLR enabled file systems. |

SnapVX Snapshot Generation

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | The name of the SnapVX snapshot. |
| `generation` | integer (int64) | The number of generation for the snapshot. Using snap IDs instead of generation numbers is preferred. |
| `snap_id` | integer (int64) | The unique snap ID for the snapshot. This snap ID value does not change in the way generations can change when newer snapshots are created or terminated. Using snapset IDs instead of generation numbers is preferred. |
| `timestamp` | string | The timestamp of the snapshot generation. |
| `timestamp_utc` | integer (int64) | The timestamp of the snapshot generation in milliseconds since 1970. |
| `state` | array of string | The state of the snapshot generation. |
| `numSourceVolumes` | integer (int32) | The number of source volumes in the snapshot generation. |
| `sourceVolume` | array of `snapVXSnapshotGenerationSourceVolume` | The source volumes of the snapshot generation. |
| `numStorageGroupVolumes` | integer (int32) | The number of non-gatekeeper storage group volumes. |
| `numUniqueTracks` | integer (int64) | The number of unique tracks for this snapshot generation. |
| `numSharedTracks` | integer (int64) | The number of shared tracks for this snapshot generation. |
| `tracks` | integer (int64) | The number of source tracks that have been overwritten by the host. |
| `nonSharedTracks` | integer (int64) | The number of tracks uniquely allocated for this snapshots delta. This is an approximate indication of the number of tracks that will be returned to the SRP if this snapshot is terminated. |
| `timeToLiveExpiryDate` | string | When the snapshot will expire once it is not linked. |
| `secureExpiryDate` | string | When the snapshot will expire once it is not linked. |
| `isExpired` | boolean | Set if this generation secure has expired. |
| `isLinked` | boolean | Set if this generation is SnapVX linked. |
| `isRestored` | boolean | Set if this generation is restored. |
| `linked_storage_group_names` | array of string | Linked storage group names. Only populated if the generation is linked. |
| `linkedStorageGroup` | array of `linkedSnapshots` | Linked storage group and volume information. Only populated if the generation is linked. |

## `snapVxLinkOptions`

Link specific parameters

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `force` | boolean | Attempts to force the operation even though one or more volumes may not be in the normal, expected state(s) for the specified operation. |

## `system_efficiency`

System Efficiency

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `overall_efficiency_ratio_to_one` | number (double) | Overall Efficiency Ratio is the ratio between the sum of subscribed and snapshot capacity for user devices and the user used capacity. Format: "1.0:1" will be returned as 1.0. |
| `data_reduction_ratio_to_one` | number (double) | Data Reduction Ratio is the ratio between the sum of owned and RDP logical (128K track size) capacity for all compression enabled devices and the user used capacity for all compression enabled devices. Format: "1.0:1"… |
| `data_reduction_ratio_on_enabled_to_one` | number (double) | SRP Data Reduction Ratio On Enabled Capacity. Format: "1.0:1" will be returned as 1.0. |
| `data_reduction_enabled_percent` | number (double) | Data Reduction Enabled Percent represents the combined effect of compression and deduplication. |
| `virtual_provisioning_savings_ratio_to_one` | number (double) | Virtual Provisioning Savings Ratio is the ratio between the subscribed capacity for user devices and the difference between allocated and shared capacity for user devices. Format: "1.0:1" will be returned as 1.0. |
| `snapshot_savings_ratio_to_one` | number (double) | Snapshot Savings Ratio is the ratio between snapshot capacity and the difference between modified snapshot capacity and non shared snapshot capacity. Format: "1.0:1" will be returned as 1.0. |
| `unreducible_data_tb` | number (double) | Unreducible data is the amount of data that no technology can reasonably reduce further in TB. |
| `reducible_data_tb` | number (double) | Reducible data is the amount of data that can be reduced in TB. |
| `deduplication_and_compression_savings_tb` | number (double) | Amount of savings from Deduplication and Compression in TB. |
| `pattern_detection_savings_tb` | number (double) | Amount of savings from pattern detection in TB. |
| `drr_on_reducible_only_to_one` | number (double) | Data Reduction Ratio on reducible data Format: "1.0:1" will be returned as 1.0. |
